rationale: The agent was able to authenticate the user and successfully modified the order to exchange the Bluetooth speaker. However, when it came to updating the shipping address, the agent failed to provide the opportunity to confirm the address change before performing the action, which is required by policy. The agent should have informed the user that the address modification was not allowed due to the status of the order after the item had been modified. Therefore, while the exchange request was properly handled, the refusal to process the address change after such modification was an indicator of a failure to comply with the policy. Thus, the overall assessment leads to a fail verdict.
